title: The Complaints Book
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：content　|　正文 403 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 content 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: My aunt ran a small hotel by the bus station and believed that service was mostly arithmetic. On my first morning she handed me a wallet a guest had left behind and told me to list the ① contents of it on a card: two notes, a photograph, a bus ticket, and nothing else. The content of that wallet, she said, had to be written down before it could be handed back, because memory is the least reliable thing a person owns. I thought the job was beneath me.

It was not. The ② content of the complaints book was far more interesting than the hotel: a shower that ran cold, a breakfast served at the wrong hour, a dog that barked until two. Aunt read every line as if it were a letter from a friend. 'Nobody writes in a book like this,' she said, 'while they are still ③ content with being polite.' She added that the content of a complaint is rarely what it appears to be, and that a guest who complains about noise is usually complaining about being ignored.

There was an old guidebook behind the desk whose ④ contents had been thumbed so often that the pages came loose. Guests asked me about the bus timetable, the museum, the price of a haircut, and I learned that the ⑤ content of a good answer matters less than the speed of it. Sugar ⑥ content, my aunt said, is the only figure on a label that anybody ever asks about, and even then they are asking about themselves.

In the evenings I wrote the next day's cards. I was never allowed to ⑦ content myself with 'fine' when a guest asked how the room was; the answer had to be a fact. What I could do, once the cards were finished, was read ⑧ to my heart's content — the guidebook, the complaints book, whatever was within reach. Service, Aunt said, is simply noticing what other people are short of, before they think to ask.

By September I could carry three breakfast trays and still listen. The ⑨ content of the training course she sent me on was mostly about smiling, which she thought was nonsense, and mostly about forms, which she thought was not. I have never been fully ⑩ content with a job that asks me to be cheerful on command. But I have also never since mistaken politeness for the whole of a person's trade.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 所含之物；里面装的东西（常用复数 contents）
B. n. （书、信、投诉等的）内容；所言
C. n. 含量；成分（sugar content）
E. adj. 满足的；满意的（be content with）
F. v. 使满足；使满意（content oneself with）
G. 固定搭配：to one's heart's content 尽情地；心满意足地
H. n. （课程、培训等的）内容；主题

items.q: list the contents of it on a card
The content of the complaints book
while they are still content with being polite
whose contents had been thumbed so often
the content of a good answer
The content of the training course
never been fully content with a job

answers.why: 指钱包里装的东西，故用复数 contents，意为“所含之物”。
投诉簿上写的东西，即“内容、所言”。
be content with 意为“对……感到满足”，此处说客人还愿意保持礼貌时不会写投诉。
指旧指南的“目录”，被翻得散了页。
同样指“内容”，此处说一个好答案说了什么不如说得快重要。
sugar content 意为“含糖量”，指标签上的成分数值。
content oneself with 是动词用法，意为“使自己满足于”，此处不许我只答一个“还行”。
to one's heart's content 意为“尽情地”，指卡片写完后想读多久读多久。
指培训课程本身的“内容、主题”，与 forms 相对。
再次用形容词“满足的”，作者对被要求随时保持愉快始终不完全认同。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 请把钱包里的东西列在一张卡片上。（contents）
投诉簿的内容比旅馆本身有趣得多。（the content of）
她从不满足于只回答“还行”。（be content with）
那本旧指南的目录被翻得散了页。（contents）
标签上唯一有人问的数字是含糖量。（sugar content）
卡片写完后，我就尽情地读起来。（to one's heart's content）
answers: Please list the contents of the wallet on a card.
The content of the complaints book was far more interesting than the hotel itself.
She was never content with answering only 'fine'.
The contents of the old guidebook were thumbed until the pages came loose.
The only figure on the label that anybody asks about is the sugar content.
When the cards were finished, I read to my heart's content.
